reference.note: SSR migration (ng add @angular/ssr) added a parallel server bundle, which roughly doubles lazyJavaScriptChunks and shikiThemeChunks since the build now emits both browser (.js) and server (.mjs) variants of the same route chunks. initialJavaScriptBytes dropped sharply because outputMode: server moves most of the former main bundle into finer-grained lazy chunks. The @kikita-labs/ui@0.4.6 sync moved docs shell navigation onto published Kikita accordion/tabs primitives, raising initial CSS by less than 1 kB. The @kikita-labs/ui@1.3.1 sync added kuiGroup+kui-field subgrid layout CSS and invalid-control stacking-context rules, raising initial CSS to 165084 bytes; limit raised to 165500 with headroom, not to hide a regression but to reflect this reviewed upstream fix. The @kikita-labs/ui@1.4.0 sync added kuiIconButton loading-state CSS (spinner slot, matching kuiButton), raising initial CSS to 165578 bytes; limit raised to 166000 with headroom, not to hide a regression but to reflect this reviewed upstream addition. The @kikita-labs/ui@1.4.4 sync added five :has()+:nth-child() rules so a horizontal kuiGroup grows its kui-field column to fill available width by default, raising initial CSS to 166214 bytes; limit raised to 166600 with headroom, not to hide a regression but to reflect this reviewed upstream addition. The @kikita-labs/ui@2.0.0 sync grew the bundled stylesheet from 166214 to 282531 bytes raw (about 29 kB transfer): per-component fallback chains replace root-level token aliases, and forced-colors support, new colour roles and layer tokens were added; limits raised to 283000 CSS and 325000 total bytes, to reflect this reviewed upstream change. The 2.0 documentation wave adds examples to existing pages and ten new component pages (each with a page, a playground and several example chunks), so lazyJavaScriptChunks is raised from 185 to 260 (measured 234 after the wave, plus headroom).
